text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a research article focused on land-use/land-cover (LULC) change prediction for the entire country of Switzerland (~41,000 km²). It develops and spatially implements multiple (three main) future land-use change scenarios (business as usual, liberalisation, lowered agricultural production) with quantitative spatial modeling using logistic regression and transition probabilities. The study includes quantitative landscape metrics and accuracy assessments of species habitat suitability models linked to the LULC scenarios. The scenarios are spatially explicit, national scale, and include quantitative comparisons of magnitude and spatial distribution of land-use changes. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, multiple scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy assessment, and mapped LULC projections. It is NOT a review article, nor does it meet any exclusion criteria. The primary objective is LULC prediction and its ecological impacts, therefore categorized as OK.
